messages:
sophie: FYI the nightly permission-sweep job removed 'support_read' from the Support role in prod clusters. Users are hitting permission errors when creating billing support tickets. :grimacing:
benji: How many orgs/users affected?
sophie: Quick query shows ~72 orgs lost support_read, mostly in us-east-1. Sweep ran at 03:12 UTC.
izumi: Is this related to the roleset schema refactor we rolled last week? I thought the sweep had a migration lock.
sophie: It should have, but the migration lock acquisition failed for one controller pod and the job retried with partial state. Looks like the guard that prevents writes on partial lock didn't run.
security-bot: ALERT: permission-sweep job (cron/permission-sweep-prod) reported "could not acquire migrations.lock" then wrote 72 role_bindings entries. See logs: https://logs.internal/permission-sweep/2112223333
benji: Ok, first thing: stop the cronjob. @oncall can you pause the k8s cron and scale down the controller to 0?
oncall: Paused cronjob: permission-sweep-prod. Scaled controller to 0.
sophie: Plan proposal: 1) run targeted DB backfill to restore support_read for affected orgs 2) block sweep until we deploy idempotent guard 3) add a small canary (5 orgs) + integration test 4) run KMS audit for any key rotation side-effects on audit logs
izumi: SQL for targeted backfill (dry-run first):
```
BEGIN;
UPDATE role_bindings rb
SET permissions = array_append(permissions, 'support_read')
WHERE rb.role = 'support' AND NOT ('support_read' = ANY(permissions))
  AND rb.org_id IN (/* list of affected org ids */);
COMMIT;
```
benji: Add an audit event for every updated binding so we can replay/verify. Also add a checkpoint table entry with the sweep run id.
sophie: I'll open a runbook and PR for the idempotent guard (check lock + write atomic marker). Also adding a migration flag to prevent partial runs.
oncall: Ran dry-run backfill on staging, no schema mismatch and permissions restored as expected.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: idempotent-guard PR -> staging (ci/4567).
sophie: We'll hold prod backfill for a 1-hour freeze after the guard lands. If we see any anomalies we rollback and run audit-driven restores. :eyes: 
benji: Good. Please post the list of affected org_ids when you have it and confirm audit events created.
sophie: will do — creating the incident doc + remediation checklist now and tagging infra & support.
